# HavokOS M4 edge cases (todo.md HavokOS M4, efuns): the efun library
# corners the reference's run_tests.pike table doesn't reach. One case per
# line, <name><TAB><body>, the body escaped as \\ \n \t. The expected results
# in m4_extra.expected.txt are the live Pike driver's own
# (tools/ref_cases.pike -extra); nothing here was hand-predicted.
#
# --- sprintf: the reference hands the format to Pike's own sprintf()
sprintf basic	return sprintf("%s|%d|%c|%%|%i", "ab", 12, 65, -7);
sprintf width justify	return sprintf("[%5s][%-5s][%05d][%-5d][%+d][% d][%5d]", "ab", "cd", 42, 42, 42, 42, -42);
sprintf string longer than width	return sprintf("[%3s][%-3s]", "abcdef", "abcdef");
sprintf precision string	return sprintf("[%.2s][%5.2s][%-5.2s]", "abcdef", "abcdef", "abcdef");
sprintf float forms	return sprintf("[%f][%.2f][%8.3f][%-8.1f][%e][%g][%g][%g]", 1.5, 3.14159, 2.5, 2.25, 12345.678, 0.0001, 1234567.0, 2.5);
sprintf float zero pad	return sprintf("[%08.2f][%+.1f][%.0f][%.0f]", -3.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.5);
sprintf hex octal	return sprintf("[%x][%X][%o][%4x][%04X][%x]", 255, 255, 8, 10, 171, -1);
sprintf binary	return sprintf("[%b][%8b]", 5, 5);
sprintf star width	return sprintf("[%*d][%-*s][%.*f]", 5, 3, 4, "x", 2, 1.23456);
sprintf colon width	return sprintf("[%:5s][%:-5s][%:2s][%:-3d][%:3d]", "ab", "ab", "abcdef", 7, 12345);
sprintf column wrap	return sprintf("%-=10s|", "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog");
sprintf column wrap right	return sprintf("%=12s|", "the quick brown fox jumps");
sprintf column wrap long word	return sprintf("%-=5s|", "abcdefghij kl");
sprintf column wrap newline	return sprintf("%-=8s|", "ab cd\\nef gh ij");
sprintf center	return sprintf("[%|9s][%|8s][%|3s][%|6d]", "abc", "abc", "abcdef", 42);
sprintf pad string	return sprintf("[%'.'10s][%'-='10s][%-'*'6d][%'0'5s]", "ab", "cd", 12, "x");
sprintf char forms	return sprintf("[%c][%2c][%-2c][%1c][%c]", 97, 0x4142, 0x4142, 0x4142, 233);
sprintf O scalars	return sprintf("%O %O %O %O", 12, "a\\"b\\nc", 1.5, -3);
sprintf O empty array	return sprintf("%O", ({}));
sprintf O array	return sprintf("%O", ({ 1, "two", 3.5 }));
sprintf O nested	return sprintf("%O", ({ 1, ({ 2, 3 }), ([ ]) }));
sprintf O mapping	return sprintf("%O", ([ "a": 1 ]));
sprintf O mapping two	return sprintf("%O", ([ 1: "x", 2: ({ }) ]));
sprintf O object	return sprintf("%O", this_object()) == "\\"" + file_name(this_object()) + "\\"";
sprintf s object	return sprintf("%s", this_object()) == file_name(this_object());
sprintf O zero undefined	mapping m = ([]); return sprintf("%O %O", 0, m["x"]);
sprintf O width	return sprintf("[%10O][%-6O]", "ab", 5);
sprintf s of int	return sprintf("%s", 5);
sprintf s of float	return sprintf("%s", 1.5);
sprintf s of array	return sprintf("%s|", ({ 1 }));
sprintf d of string	return sprintf("%d|", "12");
sprintf d of float	return sprintf("%d|", 3.7);
sprintf f of int	return sprintf("%f|%.1f", 3, 2);
sprintf too few args	return sprintf("%s and %s", "one");
sprintf too many args	return sprintf("%s", "one", "two");
sprintf unknown conversion	return sprintf("%y|", 1);
sprintf trailing percent	return sprintf("abc%");
sprintf plain	return sprintf("no conversions");
sprintf many	return sprintf("%-20s %5d %s", "name", 12, "end");
sprintf zero flag string	return sprintf("[%05s][%-05d]", "ab", 3);
sprintf space plus string	return sprintf("[% s][%+s]", "ab", "ab");
sprintf negative zero pad	return sprintf("[%05d][%+05d][% 05d]", -42, 42, 42);
sprintf big int	return sprintf("%d %x", 1 << 40, 1 << 40);
sprintf percent width	return sprintf("[%5%]");
sprintf multiline string width	return sprintf("[%-6s]", "ab\\ncd");
sprintf column two	return sprintf("%-=6s %-=6s|", "aa bb cc", "dd ee ff gg");
sprintf O class	class P { int x; } @@ class P p = new(class P); p->x = 3; return sprintf("%O", p) != "";
sprintf O function	return stringp(sprintf("%O", (: 1 :)));
printf returns	return sprintf("%-3s|%3s", "", "");
# --- sscanf: the reference rewrites the format for Pike's array_sscanf()
sscanf d s	string a; int b; int n = sscanf("12abc", "%d%s", b, a); return ({ n, b, a });
sscanf leading space d	int b; int n = sscanf("  42", "%d", b); return ({ n, b });
sscanf signs	int a; int b; int n = sscanf("-5,+7", "%d,%d", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf s before literal	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("abc.def", "%s.%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf s first literal	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("a.b.c", "%s.%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf s s space	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("one two three", "%s %s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf literal mismatch	string a; int n = sscanf("abc", "x%s", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf d no digits	int b = 9; int n = sscanf("abc", "%d", b); return ({ n, b });
sscanf hex	int a; int b; int n = sscanf("ff 1A", "%x %x", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf octal	int a; int n = sscanf("17", "%o", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf float	float f; int n = sscanf("3.25x", "%f", f); return ({ n, f });
sscanf float int text	float f; int n = sscanf("7", "%f", f); return ({ n, f });
sscanf float exp	float f; int n = sscanf("1.5e2", "%f", f); return ({ n, f });
sscanf char	int c; string r; int n = sscanf("abc", "%c%s", c, r); return ({ n, c, r });
sscanf set	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("abc123", "%[a-z]%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf negated set	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("abc,def", "%[^,],%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf width d	int a; int b; int n = sscanf("123456", "%2d%d", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf width s	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("abcdef", "%3s%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf s then d	string a; int b; int n = sscanf("abc 12", "%s%d", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf s d glued	string a; int b; int n = sscanf("abc12", "%s%d", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf empty input	string a; int n = sscanf("", "%s", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf empty input d	int a = 3; int n = sscanf("", "%d", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf literal only	return sscanf("abc", "abc");
sscanf literal prefix extra	return sscanf("abcd", "abc");
sscanf too many vars	string a; string b; string c; int n = sscanf("x y", "%s %s", a, b, c); return ({ n, a, b, c });
sscanf fewer vars	string a; int n = sscanf("x y", "%s %s", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf percent literal	int a; int n = sscanf("50%", "%d%%", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf into array elements	mixed *v = allocate(2); int n = sscanf("a:b", "%s:%s", v[0], v[1]); return ({ n, v });
sscanf into mapping	mapping m = ([]); int n = sscanf("k=v", "%s=%s", m["k"], m["v"]); return ({ n, m["k"], m["v"] });
sscanf skip then var	string a; int n = sscanf("x y z", "%*s %s", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf trailing literal	string a; int n = sscanf("abc!", "%s!", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf trailing literal missing	string a; int n = sscanf("abc", "%s!", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf whitespace in format	string a; int n = sscanf("x   y", "x %s", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf d trailing text	int a; string r; int n = sscanf("12 apples", "%d %s", a, r); return ({ n, a, r });
sscanf bad arg	return sscanf(0, "%d");
sscanf i	int a; int n = sscanf("0x1f", "%i", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf d big	int a; int n = sscanf("123456789012", "%d", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf s at end empty	string a; string b; int n = sscanf("abc:", "%s:%s", a, b); return ({ n, a, b });
sscanf two literals	string a; int n = sscanf("[x]", "[%s]", a); return ({ n, a });
sscanf compound lvalue	int *a = ({ 0 }); sscanf("5", "%d", a[0]); return a;
sscanf global	string g; @@ sscanf("hi there", "%s %*s", g); return g;
# --- string efuns
capitalize forms	return ({ capitalize("abc"), capitalize(""), capitalize("1x"), capitalize("Abc"), capitalize(0) });
strsrch forms	return ({ strsrch("hello", "l"), strsrch("hello", "l", -1), strsrch("hello", "z"), strsrch("hello", 'e'), strsrch("hello", ""), strsrch("aaa", "aa", -1), strsrch("hello", "lo", 1) });
replace_string max	return ({ replace_string("a.b.c.d", ".", "/", 2), replace_string("a.b.c.d", ".", "/", 2, 3), replace_string("abc", "", "x"), replace_string("abc", "b", 0), replace_string("aaa", "a", "aa") });
repeat_string forms	return ({ repeat_string("ab", 3), repeat_string("ab", 0), repeat_string("ab", -1) });
strcmp forms	return ({ strcmp("a", "b"), strcmp("b", "a"), strcmp("a", "a"), strcmp("ab", "a") });
lower upper	return ({ lower_case("AbC1"), upper_case("aBc1"), lower_case(5) });
strlen strwidth	return ({ strlen("abc"), strlen(0), strwidth("abcd"), strwidth(0) });
explode forms	return ({ explode("a,b,,c", ","), explode(",,a", ","), explode("a,,", ","), explode("abc", ""), explode("abc", "abc"), explode("xx", "x"), explode("a::b", "::") });
implode forms	return ({ implode(({ "a", "b" }), ""), implode(({}), ","), implode(({ 1, 2 }), ","), implode(({ 1, 2, 3 }), (: $1 + $2 :)) });
string_difference	return ({ string_difference("a", "a"), string_difference("a", "b") });
to_int forms	return ({ to_int("12abc"), to_int(" 7"), to_int("x"), to_int("-3"), to_int(2.9), to_int(-2.9), to_int(0), to_int("0x10"), to_int("") });
to_float forms	return ({ to_float("1.5e2"), to_float("2"), to_float("x"), to_float(3), to_float(" 2.5") });
crc32 forms	return ({ crc32("hello"), crc32(""), crc32("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog") });
crypt with md5 salt	return crypt("password", "$1$saltsalt$");
crypt with plain salt	return crypt("password", "ab");
crypt long salt	return crypt("pw", "abcdefghijk");
crypt empty pw	return crypt("", "$1$abc$");
crypt long pw	return crypt("this is a much longer password with spaces 1234567890", "$1$xyz$");
crypt check	string h = crypt("secret", "$1$q1w2e3r4$"); return ({ crypt("secret", h) == h, crypt("Secret", h) == h, sizeof(h) });
oldcrypt	return oldcrypt("pw", "$1$aa$") == crypt("pw", "$1$aa$");
regexp string	return ({ regexp("hello", "l+"), regexp("hello", "^h"), regexp("hello", "x"), regexp("hello", "o$"), regexp("Hello", "^[A-Z][a-z]+$") });
regexp array	return regexp(({ "apple", "banana", "cherry", 5, "avocado" }), "^a");
regexp array flags	return ({ regexp(({ "apple", "banana", "avocado" }), "^a", 1), regexp(({ "apple", "banana", "avocado" }), "^a", 2), regexp(({ "apple", "banana", "avocado" }), "^a", 3) });
regexp classes	return ({ regexp("a1", "\\\\d"), regexp("ab", "\\\\d"), regexp("a b", "\\\\s"), regexp("_", "\\\\w"), regexp("abc", "a.c"), regexp("ac", "ab?c"), regexp("abbc", "ab{2}c"), regexp("abbbc", "ab{2}c") });
regexp alternation	return ({ regexp("cat", "^(cat|dog)$"), regexp("dog", "^(cat|dog)$"), regexp("cow", "^(cat|dog)$"), regexp("x", "a|x") });
regexp word anchors	return ({ regexp("the cat sat", "\\\\<cat\\\\>"), regexp("concatenate", "\\\\<cat\\\\>") });
regexp brackets	return ({ regexp("a-b", "[-x]"), regexp("]", "[]]"), regexp("abc", "[^abc]"), regexp("abcd", "[^abc]"), regexp("A", "[a-z]") });
regexp escapes	return ({ regexp("a.b", "a\\\\.b"), regexp("axb", "a\\\\.b"), regexp("a+b", "a\\\\+b"), regexp("(x)", "\\\\(x\\\\)") });
regexp star greedy	return ({ regexp("", "a*"), regexp("b", "^a*b$"), regexp("aaab", "^a*b$"), regexp("ab", "^a+?b$") });
reg_assoc basic	return reg_assoc("abc123def", ({ "[0-9]+" }), ({ 1 }));
reg_assoc two	return reg_assoc("a1b22c", ({ "[0-9]", "[a-z]" }), ({ "D", "L" }), 0);
reg_assoc default	return reg_assoc("xx", ({ "y" }), ({ 1 }), -1);
pluralize forms	return ({ pluralize("fly"), pluralize("day"), pluralize("box"), pluralize("rose"), pluralize("a sword"), pluralize("an apple"), pluralize("bag of gold"), pluralize("Child"), pluralize("sheep"), pluralize("knife"), pluralize("man"), pluralize("gas"), pluralize("HAS"), pluralize("are") });
pluralize empty	return pluralize("");
# --- arrays and mappings
allocate_mapping forms	return ({ allocate_mapping(5), allocate_mapping(({ "a", "b" }), 0), allocate_mapping(({ "a", "b" }), ({ 1, 2 })), allocate_mapping(({ 1, 2 }), (: $1 * 10 :)) });
unique_array forms	return ({ unique_array(({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }), (: $1 % 2 :)), unique_array(({ "a", "bb", "c" }), (: sizeof($1) :)), unique_array(({ 1, 2, 3 }), (: $1 % 2 :), 0) });
unique_mapping forms	mapping m = unique_mapping(({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }), (: $1 % 2 :)); return m;
map_delete forms	mapping m = ([ "a": 1, "b": 2 ]); mapping r = map_delete(m, "a"); map_delete(m, "zz"); return ({ m, r == m });
copy deep	mixed *a = ({ 1, ({ 2 }), ([ "k": ({ 3 }) ]) }); mixed *b = copy(a); b[1][0] = 9; b[2]["k"][0] = 8; return ({ a, b, copy(5), copy("s") });
copy mapping	mapping m = ([ "x": ({ 1 }) ]); mapping c = copy(m); c["x"] += ({ 2 }); c["y"] = 1; return ({ m, c });
copy class	class P { int x; mixed *l; } @@ class P p = new(class P); p->x = 1; p->l = ({ 1 }); class P q = copy(p); q->x = 2; q->l[0] = 5; return ({ p->x, p->l, q->x, q->l });
match_path forms	mapping m = ([ "/": "root", "/a/": "A", "/a/b/": "B", "/c": "C" ]); return ({ match_path(m, "/a/b/c"), match_path(m, "/a/x"), match_path(m, "/z"), match_path(m, "/"), match_path(m, "/c"), match_path(([ "/a/": 1 ]), "/b") });
element_of member	mixed *a = ({ 4, 5, 6 }); int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) if (member_array(element_of(a), a) < 0) ok = 0; return ok;
element_of empty	return element_of(({}));
shuffle keeps elements	mixed *a = ({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 }); mixed *b = shuffle(a); return ({ sort_array(b, 1), a, b != a });
max min	return ({ max(({ 3, 9, 2 })), min(({ 3, 9, 2 })), max(({ 3, 9, 2 }), 1), min(({ 3, 9, 2 }), 1), max(({})), max(({ "b", "c", "a" })), min(({ 1.5, 0.5 })) });
member_array start	return ({ member_array(1, ({ 1, 2, 1 }), 1), member_array("b", ({ "a", "b" })), member_array('c', "abc"), member_array(5, 0), member_array(1, ({})), member_array(({}), ({ ({}) })) });
sort_array forms	return ({ sort_array(({ 3, 1, 2 }), 1), sort_array(({ 3, 1, 2 }), -1), sort_array(({ "b", "a", "c" }), 1), sort_array(({ 2.5, 1, 1.5 }), 1), sort_array(({ 3, 1, 2 }), 0), sort_array(({ 3, 1, 2 }), (: $2 - $1 :)) });
sort_array strings mixed case	return sort_array(({ "b", "B", "a", "A", "_" }), 1);
filter map forms	return ({ filter(({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }), (: $1 % 2 :)), map(({ 1, 2 }), (: $1 * $2 :), 3), filter(([ 1: 2, 3: 4 ]), (: $1 > 1 :)), map(([ 1: 2 ]), (: $2 + 1 :)) });
keys values match	mapping m = ([ "a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3 ]); mixed *k = keys(m); mixed *v = values(m); int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(k); i++) if (m[k[i]] != v[i]) ok = 0; return ({ ok, sort_array(k, 1) });
sizeof forms	return ({ sizeof(({ 1, 2 })), sizeof(([ 1: 1 ])), sizeof("abc"), sizeof(0), sizeof(5) });
allocate forms	return ({ allocate(3), allocate(2, "x"), allocate(3, (: $1 * $1 :)), allocate(0) });
# --- math
abs forms	return ({ abs(-3), abs(3), abs(-2.5), abs(0) });
random range	int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) { int r = random(5); if (r < 0 || r > 4) ok = 0; } return ({ ok, random(0), random(-3), random(1) });
sqrt pow	return ({ sqrt(16), sqrt(2.0), pow(2, 10), pow(2.0, 0.5), pow(10, -1) });
exp log	return ({ exp(0), exp(1), log(1), log(10), log10(1000), log2(8) });
trig	return ({ sin(0), cos(0), tan(0), asin(1), acos(1), atan(1) });
floor ceil round	return ({ floor(2.7), floor(-2.3), ceil(2.1), ceil(-2.7), round(2.5), round(-2.5), round(2.4), floor(3) });
# --- time
time is now	return time() > 1700000000 && intp(time());
ctime epoch	return ctime(0);
ctime value	return ctime(1000000000);
ctime no arg	return sizeof(ctime());
localtime value	return localtime(1000000000);
localtime size	return sizeof(localtime(time()));
uptime int	return intp(uptime()) && uptime() >= 0;
real_time	return real_time() >= time() - 1;
# --- save format
save_variable forms	return ({ save_variable(5), save_variable(-3), save_variable("a\\"b\\\\c\\nd"), save_variable(1.5), save_variable(({ 1, ({}) })), save_variable(([ "k": 1 ])), save_variable(0), save_variable(this_object()), save_variable(({ this_object(), 1 })) });
save_variable float	return ({ save_variable(0.1), save_variable(-2.0), save_variable(1e10), save_variable(2.5e-3) });
save_variable class	class P { int x; string s; } @@ class P p = new(class P); p->x = 3; p->s = "a"; return save_variable(p);
restore_variable forms	return ({ restore_variable("5"), restore_variable("-3"), restore_variable("\\"a\\\\\\"b\\""), restore_variable("1.500000"), restore_variable("({1,2,})"), restore_variable("([\\"a\\":({}),])"), restore_variable("1e3") });
restore_variable newline	return restore_variable("\\"a\\rb\\"");
restore_variable empty slot	return restore_variable("({1,,2,})");
restore_variable bad	return restore_variable("@");
restore_variable class	class P { int x; string s; } @@ mixed v = restore_variable("(/3,\\"a\\",/)"); return ({ classp(v), v->x, v->s });
save restore roundtrip	mixed v = ([ "a": ({ 1, 2.5, "s\\nt", ([ 3: 4 ]) }), 7: "seven" ]); return restore_variable(save_variable(v));
# --- int overflow: the reference has bignums, FluffOS (and this port, deviation #6) wraps;
# these only check that overflow is survived (it used to abort the whole driver)
int overflow survives	int x = 1 << 62; int y = x + x; int z = x * 4; int w = -x - x - x; return 1;
int overflow in parse survives	int a; sscanf("99999999999999999999", "%d", a); return intp(to_int("99999999999999999999")) && intp(a);
shift past width	return ({ (1 << 70) >= 0, 5 >> 80, 1 << 0 });
# --- files: each case creates its own files in the test mudlib and removes
# them again. A bad argument goes through a `mixed` variable: the reference
# transpiles to typed Pike, whose compiler rejects a constant of the wrong
# type at compile time.
read_file forms	write_file("/m4_rf.txt", "a\\nb\\nc\\n", 1); return ({ read_file("/m4_rf.txt"), read_file("/m4_rf.txt", 2), read_file("/m4_rf.txt", 2, 1), read_file("/m4_rf.txt", 5), read_file("/m4_rf.txt", 0, 2), read_file("/m4_rf.txt", 3, 5), read_file("/m4_nonexistent"), rm("/m4_rf.txt") });
read_file crlf	write_file("/m4_crlf.txt", "a\\r\\nb\\r\\n", 1); return ({ read_file("/m4_crlf.txt"), file_length("/m4_crlf.txt"), rm("/m4_crlf.txt") });
read_file bad arg	mixed x = 5; return read_file(x);
write_file append	mixed five = 5; mixed nothing = 0; write_file("/m4_wa.txt", "a", 1); write_file("/m4_wa.txt", "b"); write_file("/m4_wa.txt", five); write_file("/m4_wa.txt", nothing); return ({ read_file("/m4_wa.txt"), write_file("/m4_wa.txt", "z", 1), read_file("/m4_wa.txt"), rm("/m4_wa.txt") });
write_file missing dir	return ({ write_file("/m4_nodir/x.txt", "a"), file_size("/m4_nodir") });
write_file bad arg	return write_file(0, "a");
file_size forms	mixed five = 5; return ({ file_size("/test"), file_size("/test/"), file_size("/m4_nope"), file_size(five), file_size("/test/base_a.c") > 0, file_size("/test/base_a.c") == sizeof(read_file("/test/base_a.c")) });
file_length forms	write_file("/m4_fl.txt", "x\\ny", 1); write_file("/m4_fl2.txt", "x\\ny\\n", 1); write_file("/m4_fl3.txt", "", 1); return ({ file_length("/m4_fl.txt"), file_length("/m4_fl2.txt"), file_length("/m4_fl3.txt"), file_length("/m4_none"), rm("/m4_fl.txt"), rm("/m4_fl2.txt"), rm("/m4_fl3.txt") });
read_bytes forms	write_file("/m4_rb.txt", "abcdef", 1); return ({ read_bytes("/m4_rb.txt"), read_bytes("/m4_rb.txt", 1, 2), read_bytes("/m4_rb.txt", -2), read_bytes("/m4_rb.txt", 2, 0), read_bytes("/m4_rb.txt", 4, 10), read_bytes("/m4_none"), rm("/m4_rb.txt") });
write_bytes forms	write_file("/m4_wb.txt", "abcdef", 1); return ({ write_bytes("/m4_wb.txt", 1, "XY"), read_file("/m4_wb.txt"), write_bytes("/m4_wb.txt", 5, "123"), read_file("/m4_wb.txt"), write_bytes("/m4_wb.txt", 20, "q"), write_bytes("/m4_wb.txt", -1, "Z"), read_file("/m4_wb.txt"), rm("/m4_wb.txt") });
mkdir rmdir rm	return ({ mkdir("/m4_d"), mkdir("/m4_d"), write_file("/m4_d/f", "x"), rmdir("/m4_d"), rm("/m4_d"), rm("/m4_d/f"), rm("/m4_d/f"), rmdir("/m4_d"), rmdir("/m4_d"), file_size("/m4_d") });
get_dir forms	mkdir("/m4_g"); write_file("/m4_g/a.c", "1"); write_file("/m4_g/b.c", "22"); write_file("/m4_g/c.h", "333"); mkdir("/m4_g/sub"); mixed r = ({ get_dir("/m4_g/"), get_dir("/m4_g/*.c"), get_dir("/m4_g/?.h"), get_dir("/m4_g"), get_dir("/m4_g/b.c"), get_dir("/m4_g/zz*"), get_dir("/m4_nodir/x"), get_dir("/m4_g/nothere"), map(get_dir("/m4_g/", -1), (: ({ $1[0], $1[1] }) :)) }); rm("/m4_g/a.c"); rm("/m4_g/b.c"); rm("/m4_g/c.h"); rmdir("/m4_g/sub"); rmdir("/m4_g"); return r;
